an4.126:1.1: “Monks, there are these four types of individuals to be found existing in the world.
an4.126:1.3: “There is the case where an individual keeps pervading the first direction [the east]—as well as the second direction, the third, & the fourth—with an awareness imbued with goodwill. Thus he keeps pervading above, below, & all around, everywhere & in every respect the all-encompassing cosmos with an awareness imbued with goodwill: abundant, expansive, immeasurable, free from hostility, free from ill will.
an4.126:1.4: He regards whatever phenomena there that are connected with form, feeling, perception, fabrications, & consciousness, as inconstant, stressful, a disease, a cancer, an arrow, painful, an affliction, alien, a disintegration, an emptiness, not-self.
an4.126:1.5: At the break-up of the body, after death, he reappears in conjunction with the Devas of the Pure Abodes.
an4.126:1.6: This rebirth is not in common with run-of-the-mill people.
an4.126:2.1: “Again, there is the case where an individual keeps pervading the first direction [the east]—as well as the second direction, the third, & the fourth—with an awareness imbued with compassion…
an4.126:2.3: equanimity. Thus he keeps pervading above, below, & all around, everywhere & in every respect the all-encompassing cosmos with an awareness imbued with equanimity: abundant, expansive, immeasurable, free from hostility, free from ill will.
an4.126:2.4: He regards whatever phenomena there that are connected with form, feeling, perception, fabrications, & consciousness, as inconstant, stressful, a disease, a cancer, an arrow, painful, an affliction, alien, a disintegration, an emptiness, not-self.
an4.126:2.5: At the break-up of the body, after death, he reappears in conjunction with the Devas of the Pure Abodes.
an4.126:2.6: This rebirth is not in common with run-of-the-mill people.
an4.126:2.7: “These are four types of individuals to be found existing in the world.”
